quotes.text: The map is not the territory.
quotes.author: Barry O'Reilly

quotes.text: Software architects focus on criticality, not correctness.
quotes.author: Barry O'Reilly

quotes.text: Residuality Theory places uncertainty and indeterminism at the center of its world.
quotes.author: Barry O'Reilly

quotes.text: Stop constraining your imagination by how likely things are. When you do this, you introduce bias.
quotes.author: Barry O'Reilly

quotes.text: Treat every system as a complex thing.
quotes.author: Cyrille Martraire

quotes.text: When you design bounded contexts, think beyond functional coupling.
quotes.author: Barry O'Reilly

quotes.text: Residuality Theory enriches practices, not replaces them.
quotes.author: Cyrille Martraire
